facts.text: I want the assistant to keep responses nice and concise.
I am planning a Discord bot project that listens to JIRA webhooks.
I want the Discord bot to determine who to mention in a Discord server based on the type of JIRA events invoked.
I asked for suggestions on the minimum viable product requirements for the project.
I designed a draft data model for the project.
My draft data model includes a User entity with fields: jira id, discord id, type, and excludedRules.
My draft data model includes an EventRule entity with fields: type, targets, exclusion, and includeInvokedUser.
My draft data model includes a UserType entity with fields: users, name, and registeredRules.
In my draft data model, the relationship between User and EventRule is many to many.
In my draft data model, the relationship between UserType and EventRule is many to many.
In my draft data model, the relationship between UserType and User is one to many.
I asked whether there are any issues with the basic design I provided.

keyphrases: User entity jira id discord id
